brief:
@buildthis.bisks.net re shackgaze

- Plucks: Replace the saw one-shots with Karplus–Strong: y[n] = ½(y[n−N] + y[n−N−1]), N = fs/f₀. High harmonics decay first, keep the fuzz after it.
- Declick: Ramp plucks in with min(τ·600, 1).
- Duck the pad: Multiply the pad by 1 − 0.7·Σ(hit envelopes).
note: shackgaze plucks are now Karplus–Strong strings (fuzz kept), with a 600/s declick ramp and the pad ducking under hits.
